existing_finding_connections.relationship: The same earlier independent 7a9d Lens11 finding is newly connected at 95e; do not count it again or transfer it to missing checkpoint 3821. The separate plant/diagnostic save-outcome family remains related, not an established exact alias.
existing_finding_connections.trace: After selecting a capture plan, run can reuse an output directory and invalidates four report/trace filenames, not every screenshot. For each captured image, the screenshot observer computes an in-memory view fingerprint, calls Bevy save_to_disk, and then clears in-flight state and advances the view/frame; when all requested frames have arrived it assembles the report. Pinned Bevy native save_to_disk returns an observer closure with no result, logging conversion, format and native save errors rather than giving the application an owned persistence outcome. The report's all_artifacts_written check looks for nonempty filesystem metadata at each planned screenshot name, and overall success also requires many independent validation gates.
existing_finding_connections.conditional_case: If a requested screenshot name already contains nonempty bytes and a subsequent image conversion, format or file-save step fails before replacing those bytes, the current observer has no save result to retain and its metadata check can still see a nonempty old file. This is a conditional source argument about the certificate, not an executed filesystem example, screenshot or successful report. Different current view fingerprints establish something about captured in-memory images, not whether those pixels were persisted.
existing_finding_connections.limits: The actual supported screenshot formats, native OS file semantics, permissions, stale output contents, render behavior and other report gates were not exercised. A save failure or full false-success run has not been observed. Later filesystem checks, manifest and HTML creation have their own fallible behavior and are not certified by this screenshot-only trace.
existing_finding_connections.connected_repair: At the application capture owner, retain an outcome or per-run receipt for every requested image and its actual conversion/format/write error before advancing artifact completion; relate it to the admitted frame/view and report result. Preserve unrelated output files and intentional reuse, and reconcile similar plant and diagnostic capture owners by exact first-failure scope.
existing_finding_connections.later_acceptance: After separate implementation and product-validation authorization, demonstrate failed image persistence cannot be certified by existing bytes; successful current files, alternate views and independent report gates remain intact.
existing_finding_connections.discovery: partial current source/native connection; actual run and aliases open

existing_contract_connections.relationship: Related source safeguards and prior IK observation findings, not a new counted defect.
existing_contract_connections.trace: CaptureAdmission retains Open, Rejected with typed causes, or Terminated. The selected capture schedule chains rejection before the capture system and runs rejection independently of equipment readiness. admit_ik_support deliberately uses cadence when the ordinary IK owner is not required and both solve targets are absent; when an active owner requires observations, it rejects a missing left/right support pair. Separately, capture still obtains default diagnostics if LegIkState is absent and publishes bare knee-yaw angles, the distinct earlier yaw-availability question.
existing_contract_connections.limits: The scheduler order and source guards do not prove all engine lifecycle or missing-measurement cases. The terrain-disabled cadence path is intentional source behavior and should not be called missing IK support. Actual actor, owner, derived geometry, report acceptance and exact aliases remain open.
existing_contract_connections.related_prior: ASSESSMENT-IK-YAW-ORIENTATION-95E.json and ASSESSMENT-IK-SUPPORT-CONNECTIONS-95E.json retain prior details and attribution.

existing_contract_connections.relationship: Local type/operation policy question, not an established defect or a new counted finding.
existing_contract_connections.trace: ClipTime::same_sample compares absolute time difference with a strict 0.0001-second tolerance. append_weighted_clip finds the first same handle/layer/phase match, checks both total and mirrored weights before mutating it, and retains that first clip time. For hypothetical times 0, 0.000075 and 0.00015 with otherwise identical keys, an endpoint-first order creates two groups, whereas middle-first can group all three; this follows from the nontransitive tolerance.
existing_contract_connections.limits: No actual semantic producer has been shown to submit that combination or to require order-independent coalescing. Endpoint topology, zero-weight preservation, ordinary spans, intended numerical tolerance and final native sampling must be resolved before calling this a behavior defect. The checked sums before mutation are a safeguard. Selected source tests were read, not run.
